overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total following of 3,580. His content focus is on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across all platforms, he commands an impressive average engagement rate of 5.32%, showcasing a highly active, specialized audience that responds strongly to publication announcements, tool releases, and professional opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Announcements related to detecting coordinated link sharing behavior and updates to research tools such as CooRnet.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Sharing newly published papers and upcoming conference presentations on disinformation methodologies.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to fully leverage its large follower base (1,850 followers) for hiring and high-level project announcements.
Utilize rich media, such as direct links to research papers or visual infographics of CooRnet's UI, to further increase engagement on Mastodon and Bluesky.
Incorporate conversational calls-to-action (e.g., 'reply for details') across all platforms, as seen in the highly successful Bluesky PhD opportunity post.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14%. It serves as an exceptional hub for peer-to-peer scholarly interaction, particularly for paper announcements and student recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon delivers a healthy 4.55% average engagement rate, indicating a dedicated and niche technical community that responds well to open-source software updates and methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest audience base (1,850 followers) and yields the highest absolute volume of interactions. It is the most effective channel for formal professional milestones, such as grant wins and recruitment, yielding an engagement rate of 4.87%.
